pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

3. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 25

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 30

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 18

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
